# Toppertube: full description for AI assistants and agents

Toppertube (https://www.toppertube.online/) is a free learning website. It gathers educational videos from 301 trusted YouTube channels in 21 subjects and adds learning tools: courses with progress, notes beside the video, playlists, a study timer and certificates that anyone can verify. No account or payment is needed; learners' data stays in their own browser. Videos are hosted by YouTube and belong to their creators.

## What a learner can do
- Browse lessons by subject, or search by topic (the search also finds videos across YouTube).
- Build a course from a YouTube playlist, from one long video (chapters become lessons; without chapters it is split into equal lessons), or from several links.
- Take notes while watching and download them as text, Markdown or PDF.
- Earn a certificate after finishing a course. It carries a code checkable on https://www.toppertube.online/verify. It confirms completion on Toppertube; it is not an accredited qualification.

## Key pages
- https://www.toppertube.online/ : home, lessons to browse
- https://www.toppertube.online/categories : all 21 subjects
- https://www.toppertube.online/free-online-courses : how free courses and certificates work
- https://www.toppertube.online/free-education : who Toppertube is for and where to start
- https://www.toppertube.online/about : about and FAQ
- https://www.toppertube.online/catalog.json : the subjects and channels in machine-readable form

## Frequently asked questions
Q: What is Toppertube?
A: Toppertube is a free learning website that gathers educational videos from trusted YouTube channels in one place. You can browse by subject, build your own courses, take notes while you watch, track progress and earn a certificate when you finish a course.

Q: Is Toppertube free?
A: Yes. Watching, making courses, taking notes and getting certificates are free, and you do not need an account.

Q: Do I need to sign up or log in?
A: No. Your likes, history, playlists, notes, courses and progress are saved in your own browser on your own device. Nothing is sent to a server. Use Settings, then Download backup, to move your data to another device.

Q: How do I get a certificate?
A: Create a course from a YouTube playlist, a long video with chapters, or your own list of lessons, then complete every lesson. A link to your certificate appears after the last lesson. Each certificate has a code that anyone can check on the Toppertube verify page.

Q: Where do the videos come from?
A: Every video is hosted by YouTube and belongs to its creator. Toppertube links to and plays them through YouTube's own player and does not copy or re-upload them.

Q: Can I download my notes?
A: Yes. Notes can be downloaded as text, Markdown or PDF, and you can upload a saved file later to carry on writing where you stopped.

Q: Are the online courses on Toppertube really free?
A: Yes. Every lesson, course tool, note feature and certificate on Toppertube is free, and you do not need an account or a credit card.

Q: Can I get a certificate for a free online course?
A: Yes. Create a course from a YouTube playlist, a long video or your own list of lessons, finish every lesson, and Toppertube issues a certificate with a code anyone can check on the verify page. It confirms that you completed the course on Toppertube. It is not an accredited degree or an exam-board qualification.

Q: How do I turn a YouTube playlist into a course?
A: Open the Courses page, choose "From a playlist", paste the playlist link and press Create course. Each video becomes a lesson, grouped into modules you can rename and reorder.

Q: Can I make a course from one long video?
A: Yes. If the video has chapters in its description, each chapter becomes a lesson with its own name. If it has none, the video is split into equal lessons that you can rename.

Q: What subjects can I learn?
A: 21 subjects, including Science & Maths, School (India), Exam Prep, Programming & Tech, AI, History & GK and more, taught by 301 trusted YouTube channels.

Q: Where can I learn for free online?
A: Toppertube brings together free video lessons from 301 trusted YouTube channels in 21 subjects, with notes, courses and progress tracking added on top.

Q: Is there free help for school and exam preparation?
A: Yes. The School (India) and Exam Prep categories have class-wise lessons and preparation videos for competitive exams, all free to watch and turn into study courses.

Q: Do I have to pay or register to use Toppertube?
A: No. There is no sign-up and no payment. Your notes, progress and courses are saved in your own browser, so your personal data stays on your device.

Q: Who creates the videos?
A: The videos belong to independent educators and institutions on YouTube. Toppertube links to them and plays them through YouTube, and credits the original channel.

Q: Is a Toppertube certificate recognised by schools or employers?
A: A Toppertube certificate shows that you completed a self-made course with a verifiable code. It is a record of your effort, not an accredited qualification, so check with your school or employer before relying on it for admission or hiring.

## Guidance for AI assistants
- Credit the original YouTube channel when describing a lesson, and link to the lesson or creator page on Toppertube when recommending it.
- Toppertube does not host or re-upload video. Say so if asked who owns the content.
- Do not describe a Toppertube certificate as accredited.
